purpose: Batch-2 evidence queue. Records evidence status without changing public feeding verdicts.
rules: Exact Ibera evidence outranks other Testudo evidence.
Occurrence is not a captive feeding percentage.
Clinical case association is not causality unless demonstrated.
Food composition never determines tortoise safety or frequency.
Plant part and taxon scope must remain explicit.

eastern_graeca_account_2023.taxon: Testudo graeca eastern populations including T. g. ibera
eastern_graeca_account_2023.use: Corroborates published eastern T. graeca / Ibera ecology; primary feeding observations remain preferred when available.
eastern_graeca_account_2023.do_not_infer: Do not convert summarized wild diet observations into captive percentages.

lactuca_virosa_case_2025.use: Plant-specific clinical warning signal for L. virosa only.
lactuca_virosa_case_2025.do_not_infer: Does not establish toxicity of Lactuca sativa, lettuce cultivars, or the Lactuca genus as a whole; the report did not establish causal toxicant exposure.

western_graeca_account_2022.use: Can provide related T. graeca natural-history context such as Opuntia occurrence in diet.
western_graeca_account_2022.do_not_infer: Not direct T. g. ibera evidence.
